obligations.subject: The three named evaluation-seed occurrences
obligations.trigger: When the evaluation-seed manifest is parsed.
obligations.state_before: The manifest may omit, merge, duplicate, or add named seed occurrences.
obligations.state_after: Exactly the three named occurrences are present once each.
obligations.expected_behavior: The manifest contains exactly three named evaluation-seed occurrences, each occurring once.
obligations.observable_result: Validation reports the exact three occurrence identities and count.
forbidden_result: A named occurrence is duplicated or merged.

obligations.subject: The metadata attached to each named evaluation-seed occurrence
obligations.trigger: When each named occurrence is recorded or checked.
obligations.state_before: Occurrence metadata may lack provenance, applicability, missing labels, counterexample or explicit absence, or classification.
obligations.state_after: Every occurrence carries the complete required provenance and classification metadata.
obligations.expected_behavior: Each named occurrence has non-empty provenance and applicability, missing labels, a counterexample or explicit absence, and approved non-baseline classification.
obligations.observable_result: Validation exposes each required metadata field for every occurrence and rejects incomplete metadata.
forbidden_result: Provenance or applicability is missing or empty.
Missing labels or counterexample/explicit absence is omitted.
An unapproved baseline classification is accepted.
